description: GENeSYS-MOD is a linear optimisation model for long-term energy pathways and sector coupling. Its provider factsheet describes capacity expansion and dispatch across electricity, heat and transport. The provider is TU Berlin. Coverage: The factsheet documents version 2.3, with global, national and regional applications and long-term horizons. This is not evidence of the newest software version or a uniform data vintage. Access: The public provider factsheet documents mathematical scope and XLSX, CSV and GDX interfaces. Code and inputs were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The provider factsheet states Academic Free License version 3.0. GAMS and selected solver licences are separate. Limitations: The factsheet is version-specific and several documentation links are incomplete. The original student-project label does not describe the later multi-project applications listed. For simulation it supports technology investment and decarbonisation scenarios. Related resources: data-eu-envis-2060-scenarios contains outputs from a later GENeSYS-MOD version; it is not a model-family record.
